_note: TENANT ZERO configuration for RichenQuest — the single, versioned, configurable source for operational parameters (Constitution File 19: reusable, modular, configurable, versioned, no hardcode). This is the authoritative input for the Zoho CRM build (AM0.4) and, later, for Catalyst functions that must read config instead of hardcoding. Each future Titan tenant is one config of this same shape. Not secrets — internal operational config.

destinations._rule: Geography is CONFIG (picklist now, Knowledge-Graph-backed later). Never hardcoded in workflow logic.

languages._rule: Never assume English-only; templates/content are language-aware.

lead_types.model: single Leads module + configurable Lead Type picklist (Option A, founder-approved 2026-07-22)
lead_types._rule: Only Student has production workflows. Revisit Zoho Record Types only when a 2nd lead type becomes operational.

contributors._rule: CRM supports ALL contributors regardless of engagement model (founder OI-1 2026-07-22). engagement_model ∈ {full_time, part_time, collaboration}. Assignment/ownership never depends on engagement model. Team SIZE is NOT a public claim — any public team number needs explicit founder approval.
contributors._engagement_model_note: Above engagement models are placeholders per OI-1 ('some full-time, some part-time, some collaboration') — founder to confirm exact classification per person. Not used in any public claim.

ownership_roles._rule: Ownership is ROLE-based, transferable by reassigning the role — no structural change (founder OI-3).

Finance Owner.status: temporary until a dedicated Finance Lead joins

licensing._rule: Do NOT hardcode licensing assumptions (founder OI-2). Users are configurable; begin with available licensed users; provision more later. No redesign on expansion.
licensing.start: use currently available Zoho One seats; assign roles to licensed users first
licensing.expansion: add seats / guest access as contributors are onboarded

assignment_engine._rule: CONFIGURABLE ASSIGNMENT ENGINE — NEVER static/hardcoded routing (founder OI-4 2026-07-22). The config is the stable contract; the implementation behind it evolves without changing this contract or the architecture (Files 16-18).

implementation_phasing.phase_1_now_native: Zoho CRM Assignment Rules on field criteria (language/market/destination/lead_type/department/expertise) + manual override. Configurable, no code. Implements only what today needs.
implementation_phasing.phase_2_later_custom: workload-balancing + availability-awareness via a custom function (Deluge or a Catalyst function that reads this config). Added only when volume needs it.

assignment_engine.manual_override: always available — a human can reassign any record at any time (never blocked by the engine).

v1_default_PROPOSED.note: Starting routing for the current small team — CONFIRM. Expressed as config the engine reads; not hardcoded logic.

Student.overflow: Bibek (Applications) when Kunal at workload cap
Student.by_language: Nepali/Hindi routing when team capacity supports it

scale_target._rule: Engineering principle (founder 2026-07-22): never optimize for today's size; design for the future, implement only what is necessary today.
scale_target.build_today: only the minimum necessary for current operations; everything config-driven, modular, reusable so scale needs no redesign.
